## Response Analysis

```{julia}
using OMJulia
using OMJulia.API: API
omc = OMJulia.OMCSession();
installDir = API.getInstallationDirectoryPath(omc)
```

```{julia}
modelfile = joinpath(@__DIR__,
  "modelica",
  "ControlChallenges",
  "package.mo")
API.loadFile(omc, modelfile)
```


```{julia}
classname = "ControlChallenges.BlockOnSlope_Challenges.Examples.WithFriction"
ModelicaSystem(omc,modelfile, classname)
```

```{julia}
fmuPath = API.buildModelFMU(omc, classname)
```

```{julia}
using FMI, DifferentialEquations, Plots

```

```{julia}
fmu = loadFMU(fmuPath);
simData = simulateME(
    fmu,
    (0.0, 10.0);
    recordValues=["blockOnSlope.x", 
    "blockOnSlope.xd", 
    "blockOnSlope.usat"],
    showProgress=false);
unloadFMU(fmu);
plot(simData, states=false, timeEvents=false)
```
